validity.concern: PipelineType is recorded as 'distribution' but the object being built is named 'Газопровод-отвод и ГРС Струги-Красные' (a gas-pipeline lateral/branch, отвод, that BUILDS a new ГРС at Strugi Krasnye). Per this batch's own established rule (from P4085/P4092/P4093 precedent): an отвод terminating AT a ГРС is the upstream/trunk side of the network (transmission, at trunk pressure, normally operated by a Gazprom Transgaz subsidiary), while distribution is the network DOWNSTREAM of the ГРС. No source found explicitly classifies this object as transmission or distribution, so it is flagged here rather than silently reclassified.

Developer's own notice, same object name and description, confirming it is an отвод+ГРС construction project rather than a downstream distribution network.

Found the project's CUSTOMER/developer -- ООО «Газпром газификация» (OGRN 1217800107744, email domain eoggazprom.ru), i.e. Gazprom's Yedinyy operator gazifikatsii (Unified Gasification Operator), per both the RPN registry and the developer's own notice -- but this is the entity managing construction/financing of new gasification objects nationwide, not the entity that will operate the отвод once built and handed over. For NW Russia отводы off the trunk system the eventual operator is normally a Gazprom Transgaz subsidiary (Gazprom Transgaz Saint Petersburg for Pskov Oblast per this batch's source-ladder guidance), but no document found names that transfer/operator explicitly for this still-in-design object. Leaving UNRESOLVED rather than naming the construction customer as Operator.
